title: The Supabase .NET SDK is now officially supported
summary: The Supabase .NET SDK is now officially supported
body_markdown:
## What's new#


[supabase-csharp](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-csharp) is now a first-party, officially supported SDK. It started as a community project, went through a period of low activity, and is now maintained by Supabase with a team behind it. Issues and pull requests are triaged by us, and the SDK is part of the roadmap we commit to.


Here's what that means going forward:


- Work on closing the feature gap with[supabase-js](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js) , and reaching full feature-parity with our platform.
- Transform the repository into an official communication channel between the community and our engineers.
- Improve the overall developer experience, with more idiomatic designs and quality-of-life improvements.
- Provide new packages faster and more often.


## How to use it#


Install the metapackage from[NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Supabase) :


`
_10


dotnet add package Supabase


`


Initialize a client and start making calls:


`
_20


using Supabase;


_20


var options = new SupabaseOptions


_20


{


_20


AutoRefreshToken = true,


_20


AutoConnectRealtime = true


_20


};


_20


_20


var supabase = new Client(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SUPABASE_URL"),


_20


Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SUPABASE_KEY"),


_20


options);


_20


await supabase.InitializeAsync();


_20


_20


// Auth


_20


await supabase.Auth.SignIn("user@example.com", "password");


_20


_20


// Database


_20


var movies = await supabase.From<Movie>().Get();


_20


_20


// Storage


_20


await supabase.Storage.From("avatars").Download("me.png", null);


`


Source, docs, and the issue tracker live on the[repository](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-csharp) . We also provide an official[C# Reference](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/csharp/introduction) .


## Why it matters#


.NET is now a first-class citizen to build on Supabase. Official support means more features, delivered faster.
